name: Ricoh Leasing Company, Ltd.
summary: Ricoh Leasing Company, Ltd. engages in leasing and finance, investment, and service businesses in Japan. The company engages in finance and operating lease activities. It is also involved in leasing medical equipment, industrial machine tools, and information-related equipment, including multifunction copiers and computers business. In addition, the company provides industry-specific and condominium loans; wide range of equipment, including factories, warehouses, construction machinery, and smart agriculture; as well as offering accounts receivable collection and factoring services.
